reason: Primary cross-layer contract for workflow definitions, revisions, bindings, snapshots, API, daemon, and UI behavior.
Backend quality gates and required checks for database/API/daemon prompt wiring changes.
Existing execution protocol contract that must be migrated compatibly rather than broken.
Feature spans database, backend service, daemon, core types, and shared UI layers.
Implementation should reuse existing runtime/skill page, query, and API patterns before adding abstractions.
Human-readable design handoff with task breakdown and UI/data model decisions.
Accepted architectural decisions and rejected alternatives for workflow ownership and snapshots.
Canonical domain language for workflow definitions, revisions, applicability, overrides, and capability warnings.

summary: Added workspace-scoped workflow definitions/revisions, system seeded templates, project bindings, issue overrides, queue-time snapshots, and daemon workflow prompt injection.
Added workflow API routes and core API/query/mutation/types for list/create/fork/publish/archive/preview operations.
Added global Workflows page using Multica UI patterns with system-template fork, markdown editing, server preview, and project binding controls.
Added issue-level workflow override picker to manual issue creation and issue detail so small bug/research tasks can bypass project workflow per issue.
Publishing a workflow revision now deprecates older published revisions for the same workflow definition.

Aligned workflow schema with Trellis contract by canonicalizing schema_version/source.format while accepting legacy version/source.mode, and normalizing validation for applicability and step dependencies.
Updated the global Workflows editor to use Source, Steps, and Preview tabs backed by one schema object, including structured step editing with dependency/checklist fields.

Root cause: ai-desk graph preview was referenced as a concept but not converted into an explicit acceptance item, so Preview shipped as Markdown-only. Updated workflow spec, design handoff, and code-reuse guide to require behavior inventories for referenced products.
Added workflow graph preview to the Workflows Preview tab. The graph derives nodes from schema.steps and edges from steps[].depends_on, beside the existing server-rendered Markdown preview.
Added structured graph steps to system-seeded Standard Assignment, Trellis Task, Direct Task, Research Note, and Comment Response workflows so built-in templates render a graph immediately.

Root cause: preview semantics regressed at the UI layer. The server returned rendered Markdown, but the Workflows Preview tab displayed it in a raw pre block; graph/steps/tab affordances also lacked explicit UI acceptance checks.

Updated the Workflows editor UI so Rendered Markdown uses the shared Markdown renderer, graph preview can expand/collapse in the Preview workspace, Steps use numbered low-chrome rows, and Source/Steps/Preview tabs have consistent icons.
Root cause: graph expand/collapse changed the pane size but the graph viewport stayed fixed and top-left anchored; the missing acceptance item was resize-aware graph scale and centering.
Added ResizeObserver-based graph viewport measurement, fit-scale calculation with readable min/max bounds, and center-scroll restoration so graph content remains centered after expand or collapse.

Root cause: the Preview tab used one outer vertical scroll context for graph plus rendered Markdown, so long Markdown content could affect the graph pane visibility instead of scrolling independently.
Changed the Preview tab to an overflow-hidden fixed-height grid and made graph/rendered Markdown panels independent scroll containers, so long Markdown no longer pushes or scrolls the graph pane.
